remarks:
Great Getaway Opportunity — 28.9 Acres & Two Cabins!

Escape the hustle and bustle and enjoy your own private retreat on 28.9 beautiful acres.

This property features two cabins, offering incredible potential. The main cabin is move-in ready and in very good condition, with all the comforts and amenities of home. The second cabin needs some rehabilitation but is salvageable and full of potential perfect for a guest cabin, family retreat, hunting camp, or additional living space.

Enjoy privacy, peaceful surroundings, and trails throughout the property. The property sits back from the road, creating a secluded atmosphere where you can truly relax and enjoy nature.

 28.9 acres.
 Two cabins.
 Second cabin ready for rehabilitation.
 Main cabin move-in ready.
 rails throughout the property.
 Secluded and private setting.
 Potential timber value in approximately 10 years.

Whether you're looking for a weekend getaway, hunting retreat, family escape, or a place to enjoy summer and winter, this property offers space, privacy, and possibilities.

Come take a look and discover the potential of this unique getaway.
